about.title: Hi, I'm Hetor
paragraphs: I'm a web developer and a programming student. I like looking after a project from start to finish.
I aim for sites that are fast, clear and easy to maintain, and I add databases or a chatbot only when they really help.
My projects are examples of what I can do. This very page is built with Next.js and Tailwind CSS.

items.q: How do I know what I need?
items.a: Think about what you want to achieve. Show your business and contact details? A static site. Show information that lives in another service and changes often (tournaments, reviews, social posts)? API usage. Store your own data, like customers or orders? A database. Have someone answer or book through WhatsApp? A chatbot.

items.q: What if I don't know what I need?
items.a: Pick “I don't know what I need” and tell me in the message how your business works. I'll tell you what makes sense and what doesn't.
It's a way of building websites: fast, pre-generated pages that fetch data from APIs when needed instead of relying on a heavy server with a database.
It's how your site asks another service for data, like tournaments, weather or your posts, so it can always show up-to-date information.
If it connects to an API (for example tournaments or repositories), yes: the information refreshes automatically every so often.
Not always. Many sites work with APIs alone. If your project needs to store its own information, we can talk about it.

items.q: Can you build a WhatsApp chatbot?
items.a: Yes, but only when your business really needs it, for example to answer questions or book appointments.
Message me on WhatsApp with a general idea of what you need and I'll reply with questions to understand the project.
